description: This Java class defines the PaymentMethod model used in the sales management system. It encapsulates payment method details such as code, type, default selection status, and associated integration configurations.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: A model representing a payment method for the store's front-end, including metadata and configuration required for display and processing.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Returns the type of payment method.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the type of payment method.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodCode
methods.description: Returns the unique code identifying the payment method.

methods.name: setPaymentMethodCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code for the payment method.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Indicates whether this payment method is selected by default.

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Sets whether this payment method is the default selection.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Associates an integration module with this payment method.
